name: Claim Jumper at the Creek Bend

content.narrative_hook: A stranger has staked his claim right on your boundary line at the creek bend. His pick is already biting into earth you turned yesterday.

beats.text: You follow the creek to where your stake should be. Someone's driven another one — fresh wood, still green.
He looks up from his pan, squints at you through sweat-streaked dust. Doesn't move aside.
"This ground's open," he says. His hands rest on his pick like a man who means to swing it."
The creek runs between you both, cold and indifferent.

victory.text: He backs off when he sees you won't yield. You replant your stake with a curse.

defeat.text: You walk away bruised, your claim line shifted downstream by three paces.
